info.title: Ticarvo M1-M7 API
info.description: Cookie sessions and CSRF. Private catalog requires current buyer OWNER + directional APPROVED + explicit grant + PUBLISHED. Public opt-in exposes only product text and seller ID/name, never price/SKU. All responses no-store; unknown body fields rejected. No order/payment/stock API.

post.summary: Send a new verification code. Always 202, whether or not the account exists or is already verified

202.description: Accepted. At most one mail per account per 60 seconds; a new code invalidates the previous one

default.description: Problem. 400 input; 403 CSRF; 429 quota (5/15 min per address).

post.summary: Request a password reset code (valid 30 minutes). Always 202

default.description: Problem. 400 input; 403 CSRF; 429 quota (5/15 min per address).

post.summary: Set a new password with a reset code. Marks the email verified and ends every session of the account

default.description: Problem. 400 TOKEN_INVALID or VALIDATION_FAILED (an invalid password does not consume the code); 403 CSRF; 429 quota (20/15 min per address).

post.summary: Start two-step login setup; returns a new secret (replaces any pending one) for an authenticator app (ADR-005)

200.description: Secret (base32) and otpauth URI for a QR code

post.summary: Confirm the setup with a current code; returns 10 single-use recovery codes, shown only once

default.description: Problem. 400 MFA_CODE_INVALID; 401; 403 CSRF; 409 MFA_ALREADY_ENABLED or MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED; 429 after 5 code attempts per account per 15 min.

post.summary: Turn two-step login off with a current code or a recovery code; deletes the secret and all recovery codes

default.description: Problem. 400 MFA_CODE_INVALID; 401; 403 CSRF; 409 MFA_NOT_ENABLED; 429 after 5 code attempts per account per 15 min.

get.summary: List members (any member). Roles: OWNER (exactly one), ADMIN, MEMBER (ADR-006)

put.summary: Change a member's role between ADMIN and MEMBER (OWNER only; the owner changes only by ownership transfer)

default.description: Problem. 400; 403 OWNER_REQUIRED or CSRF; 404 COMPANY_NOT_FOUND/MEMBER_NOT_FOUND; 409 OWNER_ROLE_FIXED.

delete.summary: Remove a member. OWNER removes ADMIN/MEMBER, ADMIN removes MEMBER, anyone except the OWNER may remove themselves

204.description: Removed; access ends with the next request

get.summary: Pending invitations (ADMIN and above)

post.summary: Invite an email address. ADMIN invites MEMBER; only OWNER invites ADMIN. Sends a single-use code valid 7 days; a new invite for the same address replaces the pending one

201.description: Invitation created (the code is only in the mail)

default.description: Problem. 400; 403 ADMIN_REQUIRED/OWNER_REQUIRED or CSRF; 404; 409 ALREADY_MEMBER or MEMBER_LIMIT_REACHED (50 members + pending); 429 (20 invites per inviter per 15 min).

delete.summary: Revoke a pending invitation (ADMIN for MEMBER invitations, OWNER for ADMIN invitations)

post.summary: Accept an invitation with the mailed code. The signed-in account's email must equal the invited address

default.description: Problem. 401; 403 CSRF; 404 INVITATION_NOT_FOUND for unknown, expired, used or other-address codes (one shared answer); 409 ALREADY_MEMBER.

post.summary: Transfer ownership to an existing ADMIN (OWNER only). The former owner becomes ADMIN

default.description: Problem. 403 OWNER_REQUIRED or CSRF; 404 MEMBER_NOT_FOUND; 409 TRANSFER_TARGET_NOT_ADMIN.

post.summary: End every session of the signed-in account, including this one

204.description: All sessions ended; log in again
